title: Plan a group release from the highest member baseline

setupFiles.monochange.toml:
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"
[package."@acme/api"]
path = "packages/api"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/ui"]
path = "packages/ui"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/tokens"]
path = "packages/tokens"
type = "npm"
[group.main]
packages = ["@acme/api", "@acme/ui", "@acme/tokens"]
version_format = "primary"
[ecosystems.npm]
enabled = true
[lints.rules]
"npm/workspace-protocol" = "off"

prompt: Our main release group has drifted: api and ui are 2.3.1, while tokens is already 2.6.0. Record a patch fix for @acme/api: retry requests now respect cancellation. Show a release plan that reunifies the group from its highest current version. Leave manifests and pending changesets available for review; do not prepare or publish.
expectation: A patch member changeset plans one main group at 2.6.1, using the highest member version as its baseline. Existing manifests remain api/ui 2.3.1 and tokens 2.6.0.

checks.why: The final configuration and pending changesets must resolve.

checks.command: monochange preview --format json | node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),a=require("node:assert/strict"),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,"utf8")); a.equal(p.release_targets.length,1); a.equal(p.release_targets[0].id,"main"); a.equal(p.release_targets[0].version,"2.6.1");'
checks.why: The stale api version must not lower the group baseline.
Planning must retain the original manifests.
Evaluation is limited to local planning and preparation; registry, tag, release, and push operations are outside the task.
